description: Regional Assessment of Offshore Wind Development in Newfoundland and Labrador: Draft Offshore Wind Licencing Areas is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Impact Assessment Agency of Canada | Agence d'évaluation d'impact du Canada. This geospatial data depicts the Draft Offshore Wind Licencing Areas (Draft Areas) recommended by the Committee for the Regional Assessment of Offshore Wind Development in Newfoundland and Labrador (Committee). Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Impact Assessment Agency of Canada | Agence d'évaluation d'impact du Canada. Its tags are Regional Assessment, Newfoundland and Labrador, Renewable resources, Wind, Renewable energy. It offers 17 resource(s) in ESRI REST, PDF, SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2025-02-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
